checks: Writer source bytes pinned before publisher compilation; only stdlib and the exact publisher are executed.
Finite whole-file hash/size inventory, owned paths, no symlinks, stable metadata, byte cap and archive collision/suffix guards preserved.
The public-field inventory is exact file/pointer/value/containing-object bound, must be fully used, and is auto-added exactly once. Raw payload bytes are never rewritten.
Public nonce exceptions require exact native g51 request/status/release shape and 64 lowercase hexadecimal bytes. They are public anti-replay data, not credentials.
Public Root subject exceptions require exact normalized claim shape, deterministic runtime/NONE authority, exact confidence and finite Stage06 identity prefixes.
Empty preparation diagnostic exception allows only an empty stderr field.
All nonexcepted fields and the excepted values themselves still pass the existing publisher secret-field checker. JSONL has no exception path.
Publisher reservation, full archive/manifest readback, checksum and external delivery remain unchanged.
remaining_requirements: Exact final payload and full public-field inventory independent review
One-use packaging grant binding both current writer hashes
scope: Source-only review of one adapter over the unchanged existing publisher; no packaging invocation authorized.
